title: Rendering Paths Matrix — normals × uvs × triplanarScale × mipmap
description: A 4×4 grid of brick-textured spheres that exercises every shader variant the renderer ships: smooth vs flat shading (per-vertex normals on/off), UV-attribute vs triplanar texture sampling (UVs on/off), per-material triplanarScale (small vs large world-units-per-repeat), and per-texture mipmap opt-in (sharp vs aliased at grazing angles). Use it as a visual reference when reasoning about which path a given material/geometry combination will land on.
